questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Coin history' title with month headers ('SEP 2024', 'JAN 2023') and signed amounts ('-600', '+800') read immediately as a transaction log.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: There is no action to take; the list of rows with their amounts is the dominant content, as it should be.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: No controls besides the close 'X', and rows are labelled by what was bought ('Smart Bump (2/6 Bumps)', 'Notification Shoutout refund').

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Most terms are the seller's own purchases, but '(2/6 Bumps)' and '(2/7 days)' in 'Spotlight (2/7 days)' aren't explained.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks nothing of the seller; it only shows history.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each row holds only name, listing, date and amount; any deeper breakdown is left off the list.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Every row is a coin transaction for this seller; nothing belongs to another moment.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Scanning the signed amounts and green '+800' credits is enough without reading the subtitles.
